why: Forgets every running stock-loss cue on each status push (issue #230). The strip is rebuilt whenever the status moves, so a second slot losing a stock inside the first cue's 700 ms wipes the first cue mid-flight -- the composition hazard the cue record exists for. The single-loss arm cases cannot see it, because nothing is pushed after the loss they make; only the rebuild cases, where another slot's loss follows 300 ms later, can.
